'''Darth Arkous''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FAI" /><ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darth Arkous}}</ref> As a veteran in the [[Great Galactic War]], and a strong Imperial loyalist that planned the [[Assault on Tython]]. It was later revealed that Arkous had an ulterior motive for the attack on Tython: the retrieval of a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] artifact. Since the [[Korriban Incursion]], Arkous was reported to have an interest in a shipment of [[Isotope-5]] from [[Makeb]].<ref name="FAI" />

==Biography==
[[File:Darth_Arkous_on_Vaiken_Spacedock.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Arkous on Vaiken Spacedock]]
In [[3637 BBY]], Darth Arkous summoned an Imperial strike team to assist in the Empire's [[assault on Tython]]. Officially, he claimed it would be a crippling blow against the Republic and the Jedi. Unofficially, he dispatched Lord [[Goh]] to recover [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] technology hidden within the Jedi Temple. The attack on Tython was to coincide with Colonel [[Rian Darok]]'s [[Korriban Incursion|attack]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], which also hid Rakata technology. When the Empire received word of the attack, Arkous sent the strike team to retake Korriban to keep up appearances, while at the same time, the Republic retook Tython. Arkous attempted to reestablish contact with Goh only to learn that a Republic strike team had killed him. Following the reclamation of Korriban, Arkous gave praise to the Imperial heroes.

Arkous later rendezvoused with Darok on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. Together, they journeyed to an underwater base to meet with a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] geneticist named [[Gorima]], to find a way to graft the Rakata technology onto test subjects to create invincible supersoldiers for the [[Order of Revan]]. However, Arkous' former assistant [[Lana Beniko]], having collaborated with SIS agent [[Theron Shan]], sent a strike team after them. When they confronted Gorima, Arkous and Darok were watching from an observation room. With Gorima's experiments having successfully made the grafting procedure non-lethal, the two conspirators made their escape, leaving a depth charge to destroy the facility and send their enemies to their deaths, unaware that Shan was present to rescue them before the facility could reach crush depth.

Arkous later sent a coded message to Lana, explaining that he was planning on recruiting her to the Revanites, but his plans changed when she met her new allies. He warned her not to interfere with his plan, cryptically stating that the Revanites are everywhere. Lana and Shan tracked Arkous and Darok to [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] (or "Rakata Prime", as it was then known), the former capital of the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], where the Revanites had salvaged fragments of the destroyed [[Star Forge]] for Gorima to advance his experients in the building of an "[[Infinite Army]]." The Republic and Imperial pursuers, joined by the vengeful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] smuggler [[Jakarro]] and his protocol droid "partner" [[C2-D4]], confronted Arkous and Darok on the roof of the [[Temple of the Ancients]], and killed them, despite Shan's hopes that they be taken alive for questioning. However, it soon became clear that neither Arkous nor Darok were the leader of the Revanites, but followers of the true master of the Order of Revan. The master was soon revealed to be [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] himself.<ref name="Legacy of the Rakata" />

Lana Beniko was declared a traitor to the Empire and charged with murdering Arkous, a fact she could not contest due to the influence of the Revanites, and was forced to go underground with Shan and Jakarro.<ref name="Legacy of the Rakata" />

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Arkous was an extremely powerful Dark Lord of the Sith. He was of noteworthy skill in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and he was also capable of using [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force choke]].

Darth Arkous was also capable of using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and has demonstrated prowess in the use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].

==Behind the scenes==
Arkous first appeared in Game Update 2.7: Invasion of the [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The update was released by [[BioWare]] on [[April 8]], [[2014]].<ref name="Road Map 2014">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20140203|text=Producer's Road Map 2014}}</ref>

Arkous was featured as a central character in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] storyline of the "Forged Alliances" story arc, a prelude to the main storyline of the 2014 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|Shadow of Revan]]'' digital expansion. He would later reappear in further entries of the story arc, including the "Depths of Manaan" flashpoint introduced in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access, released on [[August 19]], 2014.<ref name="Producer Letter: Galactic Strongholds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20140423|text=Producer Letter &mdash; Galactic Strongholds}}</ref>

Arkous made his final appearance in Game Update 2.10: Forged Alliances, released on [[September 9]], 2014.<ref name="Update 2.10 Patch Notes">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/992014/game-update-2.10-forged-alliances-patch-notes|text=Game Update 2.10: Forged Alliances Patch Notes}}</ref> He, along with Darok, his counterpart in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Forged Alliances story arc, make up the final boss fight for the "Legacy of the Rakata" flashpoint that was introduced in the update.

After completing the "Korriban Incursion" flashpoint, Imperial players of any gender have the option to flirt with Arkous, asking him to "take some time to mark the occasion" of driving back Republic forces from Korriban. Arkous turns the player down, stating that he is busy. There are no further opportunities to pursue a romance with Arkous in the game.<ref name="Korriban Incursion">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=tactical|Korriban Incursion}}</ref>
